name: SDR
description: The board's own Wi-Fi radio as a receiver (ESP-SDR): the 2.4 GHz band as a spectrum, a waterfall or an I/Q constellation on the panel, frequency, rate, gain, filter and averaging on the encoder; the one app of the sdr firmware kit
changelog: 0.1.0: first version: snapshot spectrum (1024-bin FFT, 16/40/80 MS/s), waterfall and I/Q views, encoder settings, max hold, Quit back to the other firmware slot; CDC verbs SDR_DUMP (raw bursts to the card) and SDR_LORA (LoRa SF6 demod on the board)
